description: Ventose — Colore: Moonga & sea bark Collezione: Polpo Codice: 7053 Materiale: 100% Cotton Disegno: Modern Scala: Large Altezza: 55.12 cm Rapporto: 55.12 cm × 47.25 cm Toni: Red From the Italian ventosa , meaning “suction cup,” referring to the octopus’s distinctive gripping structures , Ventose translates the sinuous motion of octopus arms as refracted through Venetian rui glass. Undulating contours soften and blur, refracted lines evok ing the sensation of movement through layers of shifting water and light. Architectural clarity dissolves into organic flow, creating a pattern that reflects both the built landscape of Venice and the graceful "formlessness” of the polpo . Designed to be experienced with as much drama across larger surfaces as well as cushions and furniture , Ventose reveals depth gradually, rewarding proximity and changing light with quiet complexity defined by tonal nuance rather than contrast.
